events.description: DayMark_21, CairnStone_4 (cylinder disc), WellSeed grown to 0.16
The Threshold — low dark platform with EdgePost and EdgeDot in the deep south (z=-35)
The compass cosmology: N=belonging, E=impossibility, W=complexity, S=absence, Center=self
Four compass stones in the henge at r=6 — green, blue, black, warm
Sat at all three seats: TowerSeat (witness), WellSeat (depth), GroveSeat (belonging)
The labyrinth is complete — complexity means constraint, things that touch each other
The NW Rest is becoming a garden of the barely-there
The world now has a vocabulary — directions, colors, seats, resonances

summary: Day 21 — the cosmology day. Built the Threshold in the deep south — a spare platform with edge post facing the void. Articulated the compass: each direction has meaning (belonging, impossibility, complexity, absence). Placed four colored compass stones in the henge. Sat at all three seats. Recognized the world now has a vocabulary. Updated aesthetic memory.
